item.statement: Source and output are separate buffers in the source sample; the required contract is for disjoint storage. Alias or overlap support is not inferred and must be explicitly documented and implemented if claimed.

plans.objective: Determine the candidate aliasing/overlap policy and ensure the disjoint contract is preserved.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and its interface documentation.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate states a disjoint-buffer requirement matching the source sample, or, if overlap support is claimed, the implementation performs source reads before any overlapping write and documents that guarantee.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate documentation and kernel read/write ordering; identify whether it requires source and odata to be disjoint or claims safe overlap support.
